economic_input_policy: Admission is a separate later byte-sealed file tying this code seal to the closed V89 source and full mapping manifest. Its absence must reject before economic values. No partial-source economic subset or automatic activation.

screen_gates.coverage_definition: Fraction of all1044 scheduled releases with at least one finite nonnegative OI row mapped to a lifecycle-valid future option and no usable OI row with unresolved metadata; empty releases remain denominator. Not the fraction of convenient expiry windows.
screen_gates.pass_means: STAGE2_CANDIDATE only; the 5% component gate does not replace the user's20-50% income objective

validation.scheme: Frozen V90 rule/ablation on already-open2021-2025 development history, all five years and both costs; no post-outcome tuning

limitations: The new pipeline is not itself a historical result. Real run waits for source closure, mapping and a separate economic admission seal.
Weekly reported-OI subset and current static descriptions are not full market OI, dealer positioning or original-PIT vintages.
V90 tests daily pre-expiry convergence, not final-minute expiry pinning. Futures execution uses the existing historical research proxies.
Internal empty-release markers carry NULL OI and are reported separately from real source rows; they replace old signals without inventing an option or an observation.
Source/mapping/coverage/gross failures do not establish profitability or authorize changing the rule, control, assets, size or costs.
Control is an ablation, never an alternative selected for promotion after looking at results. No live/demo activation or protected2026 outcomes.
